title: gonolobus shortii
intro: Gonolobus shortii, commonly known as the Short's milk vine, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. The health benefits of Gonolobus shortii include its potential to aid in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Gonolobus shortii include alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
